results.name: Overhead Extension Resistance Band Both Arms
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, placing the middle of the resistance band under both feet. Hold the handles of the resistance band with both hands and extend your arms overhead, keeping your elbows close to your ears and your palms facing each other.
Lower the handles behind your head by bending your elbows until your forearms are about parallel to the floor, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Extend your arms back to the starting position by straightening your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your ears and avoid flaring them out to isolate the triceps.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed to avoid neck tension.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Overhead Extension Resistance Band Both Arms is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Pike Push Up
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart. Your body should form a straight line from head to heels.
Walk your feet towards your hands, lifting your hips up towards the ceiling to form an inverted V-shape. Keep your arms and legs straight, and your head between your arms.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them pointed outwards.
Push through your hands to return to the starting inverted V position, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your head aligned with your arms to avoid straining your neck.
Ensure your elbows point outwards to target your shoulders effectively.
Perform the exercise on a stable, non-slip surface to prevent slipping and ensure safety.
results.description: Pike Push Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Triceps.

results.name: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Curl it up to your chest, then press it overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then extend your arms.
Lower the plate back to your chest and thighs and repeat.
tips: Do each phase under control.
Keep your core braced overhead.
results.description: Plate Curl to Overhead Press to Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Forearms.

results.name: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding a weight plate overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms by your ears.
Lower the plate behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to return and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Brace your core.
results.description: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Single Arm Overhead Extension Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and secure one end of the resistance band under your left foot. Hold the other end of the band with your right hand, raising your right arm overhead, keeping your elbow close to your head and your palm facing forward.
Start with your right elbow bent and your hand behind your head.
Extend your right arm upward, fully straightening your elbow. Then, slowly lower your hand back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm.
tips: Exhale as you extend your arm upward and inhale as you lower it back down.
Avoid arching your back; keep your posture upright.
Focus on engaging your triceps throughout the movement.
results.description: Single Arm Overhead Extension Resistance Band is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about waist height. Stand facing the handles, holding the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing down), and lean forward slightly with your upper arms perpendicular to your torso.
Keep your arms bent at 90 degrees. Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Extend your arms by pressing through your hands until your elbows are fully straight.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you bend your elbows.
Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your chest, shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and avoid flaring them out to the sides.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Triceps Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, and set the cable at a low position. Hold the cable end in one hand and bend slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Position your upper arm parallel to the floor with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Extend your arm backward by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary, and only moving your forearm.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Focus on using your triceps to perform the extension, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Tricep Extension Machine
instructions: Sit on the tricep extension machine, adjusting the seat height so that your upper arms comfortably rest on the arm pad, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Grasp the handles with a neutral grip, ensuring your elbows are below the pivot point.
Push the handles forward by straightening your elbows and fully extending your arms while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Focus on using your triceps to push the handles, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back.
Keep your upper arms stationary on the pad to ensure proper form.
results.description: Tricep Extension Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable and hold the ends with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the rope down until your arms are straight, separating the ends at the bottom.
Return slowly to about 90 degrees at the elbow and repeat.
tips: Only your forearms move.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
results.description: Tricep Rope Extension on Crossover Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Triceps Dip Machine
instructions: Sit down on the triceps dip machine and place your feet flat on the floor. Adjust the seat height so that your upper arms are parallel to the floor when you grasp the handles.
Grip the handles firmly, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides. Slightly lean your torso forward.
Push the handles downward by straightening your elbows and extending your arms fully while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Avoid locking your elbows completely at the end of the movement to maintain tension in your triceps.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Triceps Dip Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.
